_comment: METAL progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law -- see docs/idiom-research/legal.md); these are the harmonic families from docs/idiom-research/genre-rock-pop.md section D2. Natural-minor degrees: 3=bIII, 6=bVI, 7=bVII. Static-i riffing dominates (weight 3). Quality '7' on the V of the harmonic-minor cadence forces the major-third dominant. Phrygian i-bII and the tritone axis are not encodable as diatonic degrees; that color lives in the hook/bass lanes instead. No maj7, ever (D2).
